name: Carendin Halgar
summary: In the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Carendin Halgar trains Forsaken warlocks in the dark arts. Sharp-tongued and impatient, he teaches them to bind demons from the Twisting Nether, including Voidwalkers and Succubi.

sections.title: Master of the Dark Arts
sections.body: Carendin Halgar trains warlocks in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He demands focus and obedience, with little patience for failure, hesitation, or weakness. His students move beyond simple incantations to summon demons and manipulate souls. Under his direction, they learn the Forsaken way of making demons serve.

sections.title: Subjugating the Nether
sections.body: Carendin Halgar teaches warlocks to bind dangerous demons to their will. He sends students across Lordaeron and beyond to gather ancient runes, runic stones, and pure mortal essence for summoning circles. His lessons cover creatures of the void and Succubi. Before a warlock can command a demon, the summoner must bind it, lest it devour its master.

faq.q: Where can Carendin Halgar be found?
faq.answer: Carendin Halgar can be found in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, among practitioners of fel and shadow magic.

faq.q: What role does Carendin Halgar play for warlocks?
faq.answer: Carendin Halgar mentors Horde warlocks in the rituals for summoning and binding demons, including Voidwalkers and Succubi.

faq.q: What is Carendin Halgar's personality like?
faq.answer: Carendin Halgar is blunt and demanding, with little patience. He expects quick results and despises wasted time and excuses.

faq.q: Why does Carendin require pure hearts for summoning rituals?
faq.answer: In lessons on summoning a Succubus, Carendin Halgar's assistant Godrick Farsan sends acolytes to obtain the untainted hearts of the pure. Their innocence and essence lure the demon into a binding circle.

faq.q: Does Carendin Halgar interact with warlocks outside the Undercity?
faq.answer: Yes. Carendin Halgar sends promising students to Strahad Farsan in the Barrens to continue their studies.

faq.q: Who does Carendin send advanced warlocks to see?
aliases: who does carendin send you to
faq.answer: Carendin Halgar sends acolytes who have mastered basic demons to seek further instruction, including from the eccentric summoner Strahad Farsan in the Barrens.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can learn from Carendin Halgar in Lordaeron as he guides you through trials to bind Voidwalkers and Succubi.
As an undead, you may recognize the Forsaken spirit in Carendin Halgar: he treats demons as tools to break and exploit, without pity or hesitation.
As a member of the Horde, you can look to Carendin Halgar for eastern warlock training and his coordination with dark practitioners across the sea in Kalimdor.
